Metadata.description: Craft a beautiful, interactive travel route map — drawn by AI or by hand — and share it with a single link.
Metadata.manifestDescription: Beautiful, interactive travel route maps, drawn by AI or by hand and shared with one link.

plan.title: Plan with AI
plan.description: Three questions, one drafted route. Tell the atlas where, how long and what pace; then make it yours.

new.title: Build a trip
new.description: Draw your route stop by stop: cities, nights, legs and the notes that make each one yours.

maps.title: My Maps
maps.description: Every route you have drawn on this device, ready to open, edit or share.

shared.description: {cities, plural, one {# city} other {# cities}} · {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} · {countries, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}} — a route drawn with Grand Tour.

Plan.title: Plan with the atlas
Plan.lede: Three questions, one drafted route. You edit everything after.

notFound.title: No road leads here
notFound.body: This page isn't on any map we've drawn. Head back and start a new route from the atlas.

expired.title: This map has expired
expired.body: Shared routes stay live for {days} days after their last visit, and this one's trail has gone cold. You can always draw a new one.

notOnDevice.title: Not on this device
notOnDevice.body: Local maps live in this browser only. If you saved it somewhere else, open it from there, or start a new one here.

offline.title: Out of signal
offline.body: This page wasn't saved before the connection dropped. Maps you have already opened on this device still work offline.

global.title: We lost the trail for a moment.
global.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your maps are safe — try picking up where you left off.

Chat.destinationPlaceholder: Austria, the Dalmatian coast, Kyoto and around…
Chat.askDestination: Where should this journey go? A country, a region, or a string of cities all work.
Chat.askDays: How many days do you have, from 2 to 30?
Chat.rateLimited: The atlas needs a breather. Too many drafts in a short while; give it a minute and try again.
Chat.failed: That route didn't come together. Try once more, or start from a blank page.

Editor.shareStale: Edited since you shared it. Share again to update the link.
Editor.fixBeforeShare: A few fields need fixing before this map can be shared.
Editor.redrafted: Route redrafted. Undo brings the previous one back.

stops.heading: Stops
stops.limit: Guest maps top out at {max} stops.

search.unreachable: Couldn't reach the map atlas — try again in a moment.

redraft.hint: Replaces your stops in one step; undo brings them back.
redraft.rateLimited: The atlas needs a breather. Give it a minute and try again.
redraft.failed: That redraft didn't come together. Your route is untouched; try again.

Units.title: Units & currency
Units.description: Changes how routes read to you only. Budgets are estimated in US dollars and converted at today's rates.
Units.ratesUnavailable: Live rates are out of reach right now, so amounts show in US dollars.

Upsell.title: {max} stops, for now
Upsell.description: Guest maps travel light — {max} cities and a {days}-day link. Sign up (coming soon) for a longer itinerary and a few more keepsakes.

Share.title: Your map is live
Share.description: Anyone with this link can view the route. It stays live for {days} days after its last visit; share again after editing.
Share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select and copy the link manually.

errors.tooLarge: That map is too big to share — trim a few details and retry.
errors.rateLimited: The atlas needs a breather — try sharing again shortly.
errors.failed: Couldn't share that map — try again.
errors.offline: Couldn't reach the atlas — check your connection and retry.

Maps.title: My Maps
Maps.empty: No maps yet. Draft one with the atlas, or draw it stop by stop.

card.summary: {stops, plural, one {# stop} other {# stops}} · {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} · Updated {updated}
card.shareStale: Edited since you shared it. Share again for an up-to-date link.
card.deleteBody: This removes it from My Maps on this device. Any link you've already shared keeps working.

import.too_large: That file is far too big to be a Grand Tour map.
import.not_json: That file isn't a Grand Tour backup. Pick a .json map file.
import.not_a_trip: That file doesn't hold a map this atlas can read (up to 5 stops).
